project.name: Starter: bdi-test-ldap
project.description: An Active Directory look-alike for tests (in-memory UnboundID directory, AD object classes and attributes, users under OU=Users, groups under OU=Groups with member): a Quarkus test resource that plays the platform's directory and returns the bdi-config-security-ldap keys. Add with test scope; ship your own ad-directory.ldif on the test classpath to override the default users and groups.
